description: Verify that DHCP clients use the IP address provided in the 'server identifier' option (Option 54) for any unicast requests (RFC 2131 §4.1)
approach:
[Objective]
The RENEWING-state REQUEST is unicast directly to the binding's server. RFC 2131 §4.1 says that destination IP must be Option 54 from the prior ACK (the 'server identifier'); pinning to anyone else lets a different server steal renewals.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND with Option 54 = SERVER_ID.
2. DUT enters RENEWING and emits a renew DHCPREQUEST.
   • IPv4 dst_ip == SERVER_ID   ← key check

[Pass condition]
RENEWING REQUEST's IPv4 dst_ip equals the snapshotted Option 54 value.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_renewing_request_dst_not_server_id — destination diverged from server-id.

verdicts.Pass: RENEWING REQUEST unicast to Option 54 server-id — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_renewing_request_dst_not_server_id: RENEWING REQUEST dst_ip is not the server identifier
